name: Pinacate volcanic field
used_by: NASA: Apollo astronaut geology field trips (first trip November 1965)
notes: Maars and cinder cones in the Sonoran Desert.

name: Lunar Crater volcanic field
used_by: NASA: Apollo 17 crew geology training with rover traverses (September 1972)
notes: Maar and cinder cones in central Nevada.

name: Black Point Lava Flow
used_by: NASA Desert RATS: Lunar Electric Rover and EVA field tests (2008-2011)
notes: Basaltic flow in the San Francisco volcanic field, the cell next to S P Crater.

name: Mauna Kea PISCES test site
used_by: NASA and CSA with PISCES: RESOLVE regolith volatile and ISRU field tests (2008-2012)
notes: Summit coordinates; the test site lies at about 2700 m on the same volcano, in the same cell.

name: Dumont Dunes
used_by: NASA JPL: Scarecrow test rover drives on dunes before Curiosity landed (May 2012)
notes: Sand dunes in the Mojave Desert near Death Valley.

name: Tso Kar
used_by: Astrobiology field campaigns in Ladakh (2016 pathfinder expedition; Spaceward Bound India 2025)
notes: Alkaline brine lake with permafrost at about 4500 m.

name: Gypsum Hill springs, Axel Heiberg Island
used_by: McGill Arctic Research Station: perennial hypersaline cold springs as an analog of Martian subsurface water
notes: Coordinates of the research station; the springs are a few km away.

name: Arkaroola
used_by: Mars Society Australia: Arkaroola Mars analog region (Spaceward Bound field trips; proposed MARS-Oz station)
notes: Northern Flinders Ranges with the Paralana hot springs.

name: Lonar crater
used_by: Planetary geology studies: impact crater in basalt with hydrothermal alteration as a Mars analog
notes: 1.8 km crater in Deccan basalt, surrounded by farmland.
